regions.contentLimits: One brand link and one exit action, both on the stage color.
regions.overflow: Header wraps; the exit action stays reachable.

regions.contentLimits: One scene at a time, one short heading, at most one status alert, two controls.
regions.overflow: The frame fills the available height and is capped at the phone container token; media is cropped, never letterboxed.

regions.contentLimits: One tile per published scene, two to four columns.
regions.overflow: The tile grid scrolls vertically inside the sheet.

responsive.compact: The stage fills the viewport below the header; the picker is a bottom sheet with two tile columns.
responsive.wide: The stage is centered at the phone width; the picker shows four tile columns.

focus.onOpen: The scene picker moves focus into the sheet.
focus.onClose: Focus returns to the control that opened the picker.
focus.onError: The player status alert is announced; focus does not move.

accessibility.headings: One h2 on the stage. The route has no h1 because it is a single immersive surface reached from the landing page.
accessibility.labels: Every control has an explicit label. Scene tiles name the place and their selected state.
accessibility.statusAnnouncements: Player failure is announced through an alert. Share results update the control label.
